# Test subcommands resolving configuration from root config file

# 1. Subcommand uses values from root config file
exec test-app --config-file config.yaml server
stdout 'server running: workers=16 zone=eu-central-1'

# 2. CLI flag on subcommand overrides config file
exec test-app --config-file config.yaml server --workers 32
stdout 'server running: workers=32 zone=eu-central-1'

# 3. Persistent flag passed after subcommand
exec test-app server --config-file config.yaml --zone ap-southeast-1
stdout 'server running: workers=16 zone=ap-southeast-1'

-- config.yaml --
server:
  workers: 16
  zone: "eu-central-1"
